searchDocs.title: Client​
searchDocs.content: </> type Client = { Data: T?, Key: string?, Seq: number, Changed: Types.Signal<T>, Ready: Types.Signal<T> } The object returned by DataVaultClient.Open.

searchDocs.title: Open​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient.Open(Options: Types.Config<T>) → Client Opens or retrieves a client-side DataVault instance. If an instance for the given store already exists, the existing instance is returned.

searchDocs.title: GetKey​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:GetKey() → string? Returns the key associated with the current replica.

searchDocs.title: Snapshot​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:Snapshot() → T? Creates and returns a deep copy of the current data.

searchDocs.title: GetAt​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:GetAt(Path: Types.Path | string) → any Returns the value at a path within the replicated data.

searchDocs.title: HasPath​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:HasPath(Path: Types.Path | string) → boolean Checks whether a path exists within the replicated data.

searchDocs.title: IsReady​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:IsReady() → boolean Returns whether the initial replica has been received.

searchDocs.title: Observe​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:Observe(Listener: (Data: T) → ()) → Types.Connection Observes changes to the entire data object. The listener is immediately deferred with the current data if the replica has already been received.

searchDocs.title: ObservePath​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:ObservePath( Path: Types.Path | string, Listener: (Value: any) → () ) → Types.Connection Observes changes to a specific path. The listener is immediately deferred with the current value if the replica has already been received.

searchDocs.title: Wait​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:Wait(Timeout: number?) → T? Waits until the initial replica is received. If a timeout is provided and expires before the replica arrives,nil is returned.

searchDocs.title: RequestSync​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:RequestSync() → () Requests a full synchronization from the server. This is normally handled automatically when the client detects a missing or out-of-order patch.

searchDocs.title: Required​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	DescriptionStoreName	string	Name of the underlying DataStore. Template	T	Your player data shape. Used as the template for newly created profiles.

searchDocs.title: Storage & Keys​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionKeyPrefix	string	""	Prefix added to every profile key. PlayerKey	(Player) -> string	—	Custom function used to generate a player's profile key. Mock	boolean	false	Uses ProfileStore's mock store. Useful for Studio testing.

searchDocs.title: Player Lifecycle​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionBindPlayers	boolean	false	Automatically load and manage profiles when players join and leave. KickOnFail	boolean	false	Kick the player when their profile fails to load. KickOnSessionEnd	boolean	false	Kick the player when their active profile session ends unexpectedly. KickMessage	string	—	Message displayed when a player is kicked because of a data failure or session ending. LoadTimeout	number	—	Maximum amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a profile to load.

searchDocs.title: Schema & Migrations​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionSchemaVersion	number	—	Current schema version of your player data. Migrate	(Data: T, FromVersion: number, ToVersion: number) -> ()	—	Called when data needs to be migrated between schema versions.

searchDocs.title: Saving​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionAutoSaveSeconds	number	—	Custom interval, in seconds, between automatic saves. FlushImmediately	boolean	—	Immediately flushes pending changes instead of waiting for the normal save cycle. ReplicateOnSave	boolean	—	Replicates the latest data when a save occurs.

searchDocs.title: Replication​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionReplicateMode	"Diff" | "Full" | "Hybrid"	—	Controls how server data is replicated to clients. MaxPatchesBeforeFull	number	24	Forces a full snapshot after this many pending patches. CollapsePatchesAt	number	12	Collapses accumulated patches once this threshold is reached. ClientGuard	"Proxy" | "Off"	"Proxy"	Controls whether replicated client data is protected by a read-only proxy.  Replication Modes​  Mode	Description"Diff"	Replicates individual changes as patches. "Full"	Replicates the complete data snapshot. "Hybrid"	Uses patches normally and falls back to full snapshots when appropriate.

searchDocs.title: JSONAcceptable​
searchDocs.content: </> type JSONAcceptable = {JSONAcceptable} | {[string]: JSONAcceptable} | number | string | boolean | buffer Represents values that can be serialized by DataVault/ProfileStore.

searchDocs.title: Fn<T...>​
searchDocs.content: </> type Fn<T...> = (T...) → () A generic callback function.

searchDocs.title: Path​
searchDocs.content: </> type Path = {any} Represents a path into a DataVault data object. Paths are accepted by path-based operations such as GetAt and ObservePath.

searchDocs.title: ReplicaKind​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReplicaKind = "Full" | "Patch" Describes the kind of replica payload being sent. "Full" contains the complete data. "Patch" contains incremental changes.

searchDocs.title: ReplicaPatch​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReplicaPatch = { Path: Path, Value: any } Represents a single change applied to replicated data.

searchDocs.title: ReplicaPayload<T>​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReplicaPayload<T> = { StoreName: string, Key: string, Seq: number, Kind: ReplicaKind, Data: T?, Patches: {ReplicaPatch}? } Represents data replicated from the server to a client. Full payloads contain Data, while patch payloads contain Patches.

searchDocs.title: ReplicaRequest​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReplicaRequest = {StoreName: string} Represents a client's request for a full replica synchronization.

searchDocs.title: SessionParams​
searchDocs.content: </> type SessionParams = { Steal: boolean?, Cancel: (() → boolean)? } Parameters controlling how a ProfileStore session is loaded.

searchDocs.title: MutateContext<T>​
searchDocs.content: </> type MutateContext<T> = { Key: string, Player: Player? , Data: T } Context passed to mutation hooks.

searchDocs.title: LoadFailureReason​
searchDocs.content: </> type LoadFailureReason = "Destroyed" | "Cancelled" | "NilProfile" | "PlayerLeft" Reason why a profile load operation failed or was interrupted.

searchDocs.title: Connection​
searchDocs.content: </> type Connection = { Disconnect: (self: Connection) → (), Connected: boolean } Represents a connection to a DataVault signal.

searchDocs.title: Signal<T...>​
searchDocs.content: </> type Signal<T...> = { Connect: ( self: Signal<T...>, Listener: Fn<T...> ) → Connection, Once: ( self: Signal<T...>, Listener: Fn<T...> ) → Connection, Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) → T..., Fire: ( self: Signal<T...>, T... ) → (), DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) → () } Typed signal interface used throughout DataVault. Signals support connecting listeners, firing events, waiting for emissions, and disconnecting listeners.

searchDocs.title: ReplicateMode​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReplicateMode = "Diff" | "Full" | "Hybrid" Controls how server data is replicated to clients. "Diff" replicates individual changes. "Full" replicates the complete data. "Hybrid" combines full and patch replication.

searchDocs.title: ClientGuard​
searchDocs.content: </> type ClientGuard = "Proxy" | "Off" Controls whether replicated client data is protected from writes. "Proxy" exposes a read-only proxy. "Off" exposes the replicated table directly.

searchDocs.title: Config<T>​
searchDocs.content: </> type Config<T> = { StoreName: string, Template: T, KeyPrefix: string?, PlayerKey: ((Player ) → string)?, Mock: boolean?, BindPlayers: boolean?, KickOnFail: boolean?, KickOnSessionEnd: boolean?, KickMessage: string?, LoadTimeout: number?, SchemaVersion: number?, Migrate: (( Data: T, FromVersion: number, ToVersion: number ) → ())?, AutoSaveSeconds: number?, ReplicateMode: ReplicateMode?, MaxPatchesBeforeFull: number?, CollapsePatchesAt: number?, FlushImmediately: boolean?, ReplicateOnSave: boolean?, ClientGuard: ClientGuard?, BeforeMutate: ((Context: MutateContext<T>) → ())?, AfterMutate: ((Context: MutateContext<T>) → ())?, OnMessage: (( Key: string, Message: JSONAcceptable, Processed: () → () ) → ())? } Configuration used to initialize a DataVault instance. Controls storage, player binding, saving, schema migration, replication, and lifecycle hooks.

searchDocs.title: Profile<T>​
searchDocs.content: </> type Profile<T> = { Data: T, LastSavedData: T, FirstSessionTime: number, SessionLoadCount: number, Session: { PlaceId: number, JobId: string }?, RobloxMetaData: JSONAcceptable, UserIds: {number}, KeyInfo: DataStoreKeyInfo , Key: string, OnSave: Signal<>, OnLastSave: Signal<"Manual" | "External" | "Shutdown">, OnSessionEnd: Signal<>, OnAfterSave: Signal<T>, IsActive: (self: Profile<T>) → boolean, Reconcile: Fn<any>, EndSession: Fn<any>, AddUserId: ( self: Profile<T>, UserId: number ) → (), RemoveUserId: ( self: Profile<T>, UserId: number ) → (), MessageHandler: ( self: Profile<T>, Fn: ( Message: JSONAcceptable, Processed: () → () ) → () ) → (), Save: Fn<any>, SetAsync: Fn<any> } The ProfileStore session surface used by DataVault. This exposes only the profile fields and operations that DataVault interacts with.

searchDocs.title: Init​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVault:Init(Options: Types.Config<T>) → {} Initializes DataVault using the provided configuration. On the server, this opens a server-side DataVault instance. On the client, this opens a client-side DataVault instance. Version: string, Server: any?, Client: any?, }

searchDocs.title: Mutation Hooks​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	DescriptionBeforeMutate	(Context: MutateContext<T>) -> ()	Called immediately before a mutation is applied. AfterMutate	(Context: MutateContext<T>) -> ()	Called immediately after a mutation is applied.  The mutation context contains:  { Key = string, Player = Player?, Data = T, }

searchDocs.title: 1. Create a Shared Module​
searchDocs.content: Create a ModuleScript (e.g. SharedVault) that both server and client can require:  -- SharedVault.luau local DataVault = require(path.to.DataVault) return DataVault:Init({ StoreName = "PlayerData_v1", Template = { Coins = 0, Level = 1, Inventory = {}, -- your full data shape here }, -- Optional (see Configuration page) -- KeyPrefix = "Player_", -- UseMock = true, -- KickOnFail = true, -- AutoSaveSeconds = 30, })

searchDocs.title: 2. Server Usage​
searchDocs.content: -- Server.luau local SharedVault = require(path.to.SharedVault) local Vault = SharedVault.Server Vault:OnPlayerJoin(function(session) print(session.Data.Coins) -- Simple set session:Set("Coins", session.Data.Coins + 100) -- Path-based set session:Set({"Inventory", "Sword"}, true) -- Full mutate session:Mutate(function(data) data.Level += 1 return data end) end)

searchDocs.title: 3. Client Usage​
searchDocs.content: -- Client.luau local SharedVault = require(path.to.SharedVault) local Vault = SharedVault.Client -- Get the current session (or wait for it) local session = Vault:Get() -- non-yielding -- or local session = Vault:Wait() -- yields until ready print(session.Data.Coins) session.Changed:Connect(function(path, value) print(`Changed: {path}, {value}`) end)   caution Client data is read-only. All mutations must happen on the server.

searchDocs.title: Creator Store (Recommended)​
searchDocs.content: Get the latest model here: https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/138095696448114

searchDocs.title: From DevForum / Releases​
searchDocs.content: Download the latest .rbxm from the DevForum post or GitHub Releases.Place the DataVault folder into ReplicatedStorage (or any shared location).Enable API Services in your game settings (Game Settings → Security → Enable Studio Access to API Services).

searchDocs.title: Wally​
searchDocs.content: [dependencies] DataVault = "soggybird0/datavault@0.1.0"

searchDocs.title: Folder Structure​
searchDocs.content: After installing you should see something like:  ReplicatedStorage └── DataVault.luau ├── Types.luau ├── Server.luau ├── Client.luau ├── Util.luau └── Libraries ├── ProfileStore.luau ├── Signal.luau └── Remote.luau   info DataVault includes its own copy of ProfileStore, Signal, and Remote for convenience. You do not need to install ProfileStore separately unless you want to use it elsewhere.

searchDocs.title: Why DataVault?​
searchDocs.content: Feature	BenefitFully typed	Autocomplete + type safety for your entire data shape Automatic replication	Clients stay in sync with minimal network traffic Session signals	Easy OnJoin, Changed, load/end events ProfileStore under the hood	Session locking, auto-save, and battle-tested reliability

searchDocs.title: Open​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer.Open(Options: Types.Config<T>) → Server Opens a new DataVault store. The returned server object manages ProfileStore sessions, data mutations, replication, observations, and player binding.

searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:LoadSessionAsync( Key: string, Params: Types.SessionParams? ) → Types.Profile<T>? Loads a ProfileStore session for an arbitrary key. If a session for the key is already active, the existing profile is returned instead.

searchDocs.title: LoadPlayerAsync​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:LoadPlayerAsync( Player: Player , Params: Types.SessionParams? ) → Types.Profile<T>? Loads a player's ProfileStore session. The player's UserId is automatically added to the profile for ProfileStore's GDPR-related user identification.

searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:GetData(Key: string) → T? Returns the live data table for a session. The returned table is the actual profile data and should not be modified directly. Use Server:Mutate when changing data.

searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Snapshot(Key: string) → T? Returns a deep copy of a session's data. Unlike Server:GetData, modifying the returned table does not modify the profile.
